utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, everybody. Good afternoon to you, registrar. You could kindly call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honours. This is case number IT-05-88-T, the Prosecutor versus Vujadin Popovic et al.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. For the record, all the accused are here. From the Defence teams I notice the absence of Mr. Haynes, Ms. Condon and that's it, I think. Prosecution, I notice the presence of Mr. McCloskey and Mr. Thayer. All right. Any preliminaries?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No, Mr. President, I think we are ready to go.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Before we proceed, just for the record, we will be proceeding in closed session soon after I finish making this statement, to hear the testimony via videolink of another witness. Before we do so, is it the case of applying Rule 90(E) in this case or not, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No. We have never done that and I don't think there is a need at this point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. One other question. Have you met with this witness yourself before?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I have not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: I'm asking for a very simple question so that I usually -- I say you've met Mr. McCloskey already but in this case, he hasn't met you, in other words.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: No, he doesn't know me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay. All right. We are proceeding pursuant to Rule 15 bis due to the absence of Judge Stole, who tried his best to be with us today but he didn't -- wasn't feeling in a condition to continue. So he's gone home and we will be proceeding without him. Okay. Having said that, I think we will now go into closed session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Merci. So now do you have any -- for the record, we finished with the videolink connection during which we heard the testimony of Witness PW-109. Now, it's time for the break, but if we went wrong with our estimate and there is no further evidence or business to -- evidence to be heard or business to transact, we will need to adjourn. Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: We could squeeze someone in but I think given that it's Friday and that we are going to have a little time next week, I would prefer and I think everyone would prefer that we adjourn.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: All right. I just want to confirm with the Defence teams that they are au courant with the schedule for next week. Have you been kept informed as to who is giving evidence on Monday and on Tuesday? I am more interested in those two days particularly in view of the issue raised by Madam Nikolic yesterday or the day before. Madam Nikolic, is the arrangement that has been circulated to your satisfaction?

utterances.speaker: MS. NIKOLIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] It is, Your Honour, thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. McCloskey?

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: Just we had that one exhibit, the pseudonym sheet, to offer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: That's P02877.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. MCCLOSKEY
utterances.text: I've been reminded that we did not put a 65 ter summary for the witness. Perhaps if we could go into private session just out of an abundance of caution. It's 188.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Yes. Let's go into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We are back in open session, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. McCloskey, recapitulating, there is no need for you to present a 65 ter summary, there being a consensus that at this point it is not needed. And secondly, the sheet of paper with the name and surname of the last witness is admitted and will be kept under seal. There being no further business to transact, we stand adjourned until Monday, at 9.00 in the morning. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE AGIUS
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 3rd day of September, 2007, at 9.00 a.m. 24 25

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 3.53 p.m.,
